items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: Uh, no, I sure know. I forgot him, because we didn't call him anything but Syke.

ctx.x: Oh, I see, man. So he just missed him. We just missed him there. Now, Skycar College, do you know his real name?
Uh, no, I sure know. I forgot him, because we didn't call him anything but Syke. Syke. Syke. Well, some say Syke. Yeah. And some say Syke. Uh, he's living in Chicago, I understand.
